title: Yellow · headline + body + photo
description: Process emails where the next action is explained in the body below.
usage: Step-forward hero. Headline and explanation first, supporting photo closes the band. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: JPG, cover crop. 16px corner radius applied inline via CSS (square in Outlook).

notes: [3/2] is a product-version merge field shown in magenta (#FF00F5) — replace before send.
Photo corners are rounded with inline border-radius:16px; Outlook desktop shows square corners.
Headline drops from 38px to 28px on mobile; padding 48→32px, gaps 32→24px.
